reviewer: Codex assistant, not an independent human or customer review
scope: Twelve actual rendered training images per category in five contact sheets; not an inspection of the complete corpus or model evaluation
initial_finding: Barcode and redaction/wireframe fonts passed technical glyph checks but were not readable Latin-text examples
action: Stopped the unapproved first draft gracefully at 366000 images; preserved it under data/v3/cache/pre_review; excluded 11 selected utility-font families; froze a separate readable-family split before training
completed_corpus_review: Regenerated all five contact sheets after generation completed and inspected 60 actual training examples from 60 families. No barcode/redaction blocks, blank samples, or obvious clipping in those sheets. Thin and decorative text can still be difficult; this is not a claim of exhaustive human readability review.
remaining_limitations: Visual sampling does not prove every text crop is readable
Official category labels can be visually ambiguous
Exact glyph hashing does not remove every near-related typeface
